preconditions.description: The number of cities n must be between 2 and 20,000.
The number of citizens m must be between 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= n and 1 <= u <= n and v != u for v, u in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road must connect two distinct cities within the range of 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= n and 1 <= yi <= n and xi != yi for xi, yi in citizens)
preconditions.description: Each citizen must live in one city and work in another city, both within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The total number of puppies k must be between 1 and n.
The sum of puppies given to citizens and guardians must equal the total number of puppies k.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= m for ai in citizens_with_puppies)
postconditions.description: The indices of citizens receiving puppies must be valid and within the range of 1 to m.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= bi <= n - 1 for bi in guardians_with_puppies)
postconditions.description: The indices of roads receiving puppies must be valid and within the range of 1 to n - 1.
